title: Grilled Lamb Chops with Herb Crust
description: A simple recipe for lamb chops with a herby crust, perfect for a quick dinner. The lamb is marinated in a mixture of olive oil, garlic, and herbs before being grilled to perfection.
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together olive oil, rosemary, thyme, garlic, salt, and pepper.
Add the lamb chops to the bowl and toss to coat with the herb mixture.
Let the lamb marinate for at least 15 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the marinade and grill for 4-5 minutes per side, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Let the lamb rest for 5 minutes before serving.
